mentions.author: thomasahle
mentions.story: Fuzzy string matching using cosine similarity
mentions.text:
Many people comment that there are nicer string-distance measures.

However the real advantage of cosine distance is that you can perform dimensionality reduction (see e.g. page 38 of [1]).
This allows you to work with very large documents efficiently and fuzzy. It also allows you to create efficient data structures for finding similar strings and much more.
